==Frequency of actual Hunts vs. mere tellings of the epic==
There is some mention in TGH, by Thom perhaps, that the Great Hunt has been called for the first time in a long time (since the hundred years war, IIRC?).  Do we know when exactly actual Hunts have been called (if so, should be mentioned at [[Horn of Valere]]) and how does that compare to how often gleemen/bards tell the epic?  Isn't the later considerably more frequent, so isn't it wrong to say it is told "usually after an official hunt has been called by Illian." ? --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 05:24, 8 March 2007 (UTC)
